svg.text: Five layers · grounded in official bare acts · guarded in and out · every claim cited · every step traced

g.text: router as manager · parallel researchers · critic loop · interrupt() for advocate review · checkpoint per chat

svg.text: Flow: input guard → law-in-force → router ⇉ researchers → writer → critic ↺ → output guard → cited answer
Own-case advice → escalation agent → advocate consult · nano for guard and router, gpt-5.4 for writer and critic
Policy: public legal sources only · legal information, not legal advice · never predicts a case outcome
Tools: law_search() · get_section() · run_sql() · create_brief() · payments API · PDF section parser
Ingest: India Code PDF → section parser → embed (text-embedding-3-large) → pgvector
Retrieve: direct section lookup → dense + BM25 → rank fusion → keep acts in force on the date
LlamaIndex runs ingestion and retrieval; the LangGraph writer writes the answer
User or advocate asks in chat
Agents retrieve from the law library
Every step traced and scored in Langfuse
